## Activity

The layer-matrix **Activity** record: one timeline entry — `activityType` enum (note/call/email/meeting/status change, each with its own icon), `summary`, markdown `body`, `occurredAt`, `author = linksTo(User)`, and `about = linksTo(CardDef)` so an activity can attach to ANY record (deal, invoice, account…). The embedded format is a timeline row — the Customer 360 right panel is a reverse-chronological query over `about`.

```ts
import { Activity } from '../activity';
// timeline = query Activity where about = this account/deal/invoice
```

**Non-goals:** reminders/scheduling (Remind tool, deferred), automatic capture from email/calendar sync (out of scope per spec), threaded comments.
